نستعيي (form X)
# نَسْتَعْيِي (nastaʕyī) /nas.taʕ.jiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْيَا (istaʕyā)
# نَسْتَعْيِيَ (nastaʕyiya) /nas.taʕ.ji.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْيَا (istaʕyā)
